teacher_info.about_teacher:
I think of myself more as an "English coach". There is so much more involved in learning English than rules and book knowledge. 
 
It is important to know English rules, however (everyday natural English) is often very different. A number of factors help us to sound natural. Needless to say, it depends on your goals.
 
In the past, I’ve had an opportunity to assist native adult speakers with their English skills. This experience has played a role in how I help students today.
 
I’ve been an online English teacher for nearly 5 years and have taught upwards of 5000 lessons. I have seen almost any situation a non native might be in, so can likely help you too!
teacher_info.teaching_style:
My lesson methodology is quite simple... I do what works for you as an individual. 

Everyone is different. Methods often work differently from person to person. Spending a sufficient amount of time on any task is important to make sure its understood well.

Slow and steady wins the race. Therefore, it's my goal to provide a comfortable, modernized, relaxing environment for you to improve your English.  

My sessions tend to be quite interactive with articles, video clips and other useful media. Some people prefer a more (strict) style of teacher. If that is what you like, I may not be the person you are looking for.  My style is intentionally relaxed. However, please check for yourself!

pro_course_detail.description:

Do you like homework?  Me too!  Your time is valuable, and homework helps you get the most out of class time. I enjoy sending a short article or video before each class.  You can choose a topic that you are interested in, or I can choose the topic. Then I will bring some interesting discussion questions to class so we will always have something unique to talk about.  The homework is always optional, but it helps you get the most out of our time together.

This is a relaxed type of class. Mistakes are a part of the learning process and allow us to grow. 
I encourage you to take risks, make mistakes, and enjoy the process. Throughout the class, I will take notes on a shared Google Doc with suggestions to help you sound more like a native speaker, as well as new words and phrases.  This way, you can review after class.

pro_course_detail.title: General English
pro_course_detail.description:
Are you looking for a structured plan that will take you to the next level? Then this class is for you! This course follows a logical sequence. First we will learn new vocabulary words, practice seeing them in context, then practice using them out loud.  We will also cover all the grammar points necessary in order to master the English language.

Since these are private lessons, they are 100% customized to your needs.  Not sure when to use the past perfect? Then we can start with the past perfect.  Or would you rather focus on vocabulary related to business?  You're the boss.  During your first lesson, we will create a learning plan to help you accomplish your goals. But if you're not sure where to start, I can do a short assessment of your current level, and help you decide where to begin.  

This course typically involves reading, writing, speaking, and listening exercises. In order to get the most out of your class time, most of the reading, writing, and listening exercises are given as homework.  This way, we can spend more time speaking during class.  And of course, we will focus more on the skills that are most relevant to your goals.

Before the first class, please send me a message informing me which exam you will be taking and the exam date. This way, we can create a study plan that is specific to your needs. If your exam date is soon, we can get down to business by practicing the speaking portion of the exam, linking words, and exam tips.  If you have several weeks to prepare, we can cover all four portions of the exam. If you have several months to prepare, we can even follow a textbook.
